page_title: HAV 1-2 MAR | Le Havre v Marseille 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Jeremy Stinat has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Pau Lopez into the bottom right corner.

90+5' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Le Havre!
90+5' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Celebrations are cut short for Le Havre as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Le Havre players aren’t happy.
90+1' Goal! Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
90+1' A great pass puts Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Jean Onana (Marseille) replaces Luis Henrique.
87' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
85' The substitution is prepared. Alois Confais (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daler Kuzyaev.
82' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' It's time for a substitution. Sofiane Sidi Ali (Marseille) comes on in place of Jonathan Clauss.
77' 0 - 2 Michael Murillo (Marseille) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes in off the left post and the score changes to 0:2.
75' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
75' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' A quickly taken corner by Le Havre.

74' A pass into the box finds Andre Ayew (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Pau Lopez denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Le Havre.
73' Here is a change. Abdoulaye Toure is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre).
73' Yoann Salmier goes off the pitch and Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) comes on.
72' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
71' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) replacing Faris Moumbagna.
71' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
70' Jean-Louis Gasset decides to make a substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
70' That will be all from Ulisses Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Quentin Merlin (Marseille).

69' A pass into the box finds Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Pau Lopez denies him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Le Havre.
67' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Josue Casimir is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
67' Antoine Joujou comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Clauss tees up Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
63' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) makes a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
61' 41:59 – the ratio of ball possession.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

56' Arthur Desmas makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.

56' A neat pass is well received by Faris Moumbagna (Marseille), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
56' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
54' Luis Henrique (Marseille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
52' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

52' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.

50' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.

47' That was close by Luis Henrique (Marseille)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
45+2' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 3:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
42' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Arthur Desmas.
38' The Le Havre players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
35' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremy Stinat signals.

33' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
31' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
30' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' A pass into the box finds Andre Ayew (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Pau Lopez denies him.

21' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
18' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
16' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

16' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
13' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
10' Arthur Desmas displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
6' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Pau Lopez, who makes a comfortable save.

3' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat is the one to supervise the game today.
